author: _Gill
body:
Hello everyone, Max here:
I just want to let everyone know that I love this server through and through. Ive been a member of it for longer than any of you guys, and I still do love it. Its just that I have been noticing some staff issues lately...
Now, I don't know what has changed since I left, but something clearly has... First off, I can't seem to get hold of a Sr Mod for the life of me. I don't know the formal way of doing it now, but I thought you should just msg them on Skype, and they would get back to you in a reasonable amount of time... Well, Ive reported some players that should be forum banned, glitches Ive noticed, and some simple issues that should be solved. I thought "What the hell, its only been three hours, I guess no one is on." Clearly, someone was on, but most likely ignoring me. I know this because I was in Ivy's TeamSpeak room, waiting for a Sr Staff member to come online, I was later moved out of the room, so I continued to join. Soon enough, a Mod had taken away my Retired Rank at the request of a Sr Staff member... First off, I didn't know mods could change ranks (kinda scary), but then I realized a glitch. I was eager to report it to a staff member, and I did this by demonstrating the glitch (nothing big), I was immediately banned by another staff member, who obviously didn't research the issue, or even take note that a glitch was there. There was 0 communication between the staff member that banned me and myself. Kinda just banned right off the bat (no questions about the glitch). 

So, with this in mind, here are my issues that I have noticed in the past few days:
  • Staff members in general have had issues communicating with the community in total. This is primarily seen in the rules dilemma that happened earlier this week. I know that Jake and Jozz are on leave, but come on Sr Staff, can you really not handle the situation? Also, its nearly impossible to contact a Sr Staff member about a personal issue, whether its Skype or email. The only way Ive found it possible to communicate with staff members is through texting, which 99% of the server doesn't have access to.
  • Secondly, I have noticed some rash and rather stupid decisions by some staff members. Primarily with me being banned. I wasn't asked how I performed the glitch by the staff member who banned me, I was just kinda banned in 3 seconds. 
These are the primary problems I have noticed... And I suggest a staff meeting and revamp soon... I also propose that I be given the TeamSpeak Dev rank on TeamSpeak, considering I'm one of the few that understands the permissions, and because I think I am trustworthy enough (I don't care too much though, the problems with TeamSpeak are quite hysterical).

Thank you for reading,
Max

No thanks, any system like that will — invariably — result in heavy biased influence and favoritism akin to a popularity contest. Having come from a server that condoned public input on staff applications and who to hire, I can tell you from firsthand experience that lifting the stricture and letting players vote on moderators is one of the worst things you could do... in fact, I gave up a promotion to administrator to spend more time on Avicus, which had (and still has) a much more tolerable staff system.

Well, actually, I guess everything would depend on the degree to which you allow community input; but don't go complaining about the "hidden gems" of the server never getting hired, as I hear that far too often...
